_key.description: Coding variant key, phenotype ontology term and source file accession, joined by underscores.

pathogenicity_score.description: MutPred2 pathogenicity score for the substitution, between 0 and 1. Higher values indicate greater predicted pathogenicity.

property_scores.description: Molecular mechanisms MutPred2 predicts the substitution to disrupt, drawn from its 58 structural, functional, and post-translational-modification properties. Only mechanisms reaching a posterior probability of 0.25 or higher with a p-value below 0.05 are retained. Each entry carries the property, its posterior probability, p-value, affected position, and whether the property is Lost, Gained, or Altered; the affected position is "-" for properties that describe a whole region rather than a residue.

Property.description: MutPred2 molecular mechanism property name (e.g. VSL2B_disorder, Surface_accessibility, Stability)

Posterior Probability.description: Posterior probability that the mechanism is altered

Effected Position.description: Affected residue position (e.g. "Y183"), or "-" for properties that describe a region rather than a single residue

Type.description: Direction of the predicted mechanism change

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this measurement was read from.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the sample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when the fileset lists no sample.

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the sample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when the fileset carries no summary.
biological_context.example: glutamatergic neuron differentiated cell specimen, pooled cell
